verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              ब्रह्मणा देवदेवेन सार्धं सलिलयोनिना। ब्रह्मलोकगतो ब्रह्मन्वैकुण्ठः किं चकार ह॥१॥
verses.english: janamejaya queried vaishampAyana: “O brahman, what did the god of gods, viShNu, do after going to the abode of brahma along with god brahma?

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थे चादिदेवेन नीतः कमलयोनिना। विष्णुर्दैत्यवधे वृत्ते देवैश्च कृतसत्क्रियः॥२॥
verses.english: Why creator-brahma took viShNu to brahma’s abode, when viShNu stood worshipped by gods after the elimination of daityA-s?
verses.bhavadeepa: पञ्चाशेऽध्याय एकोने ब्रह्मलोकस्य वर्णनम्। तत्रापि यजनं विष्णोर्मुनिभिः कृतमीर्यते॥१॥ ब्रह्मणा सलिलं सलिलाश्रयं कमलं योनिः उत्पत्तिस्थानं यस्य तेन॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोके च किं स्थानं कं वा योगमुपास्त सः। कं वा दधार नियमं स विभुर्भूतभावनः॥३॥
verses.english: What is his position in brahma’s abode, what sort of Yoga he practised there and what sort of regulalions he observed?
verses.bhavadeepa: नीतो ब्रह्मलोकमित्यनुकृष्यते॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: कथं तस्याऽऽसतस्तत्र विश्वं जगदिदं महत्। श्रियमाप्नोति विपुलां सुरासुरनरार्चिताम्॥४॥
verses.english: This holy and supreme soul, who accords fruits of rituals to the performers, holds impalpable strings of the mechanics of worlds, like a puppeteer manipulating unseeable puppetry strings, as the hymns stowing inexplicable hymnal efficacy in hymns themselves… thinking in this way the sages addressed viShNu saying:
verses.bhavadeepa: उपास्त उपास्ते॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: कथं स्वपिति घर्मान्ते बुध्यते चाम्बुदप्लवे। कथं च ब्रह्मलोकस्थो धुरं वहति लौकिकाम्॥५॥
verses.english: The sages and the gods available in the assemblages of Vedic ritiual then addressed the visitor, viShNu, interspersing sacred grass in their fingers and placing a vessel with sacred water – अर्घ्य – water for canon-welcome, in the bowl of their palms that are a little upraised to their chest level, calling this to mind:
verses.bhavadeepa: आसतः आददानस्य पूजामिति शेषः। "अस(ष) गतिदीप्त्यादानेषु” (१ उ० सेट्) इत्यस्य रूपम् आसत इति॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: चरितं तस्य विप्रेन्द्र दिव्यं भगवतो दिवि। विस्तरेण यथातत्त्वं सर्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥६॥
verses.english: “O foremost of the celestials, O thou of great effulgence, O lotus-navelled deity, hast thou come with ease? Do thou accept this ritual guestship offered according to sacred hymns…?
verses.bhavadeepa: घर्मान्त आषाढ्याम् अम्बुदप्लवे मेघानां नाशे सति कार्तिक्यामित्यर्थः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              शृणु नारायणस्यादौ विस्तरेण प्रवृत्तयः। ब्रह्मलोकं यथारूढो ब्रह्मणा सह मोदते॥७॥
verses.english: O vaishampAyana, foremost of brAhmaNa-s, I wish to hear true account of the celestial conduct of this lord nArAyaNa in the land of gods…

verses.sanskrit: कामं तस्य गतिः सूक्ष्मा देवैरपि दुरासदा। यत्तु वक्ष्याम्यहं राजंस्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रवृतयः प्रवृतीः कर्माणीति यावत्॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: एष लोकमयो देवो लोकाश्चैतन्मयास्त्रयः। एश देवमयश्चैव देवाश्चैतन्मया दिवि॥९॥
verses.english: नारायण is transposable with the triad of worlds or vice versa, as we don’t call a cloth as yarn, or pot as a clod, or vice versa… so also, he is the fabric of the heavens and gods, or vice versa…
verses.bhavadeepa: ये मत्सकाशात् तत् ‘विष्णोश्चरित्रम्’॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पारं न पश्यन्ति बहवः पारचिन्तकाः। एश पारं परं चैव लोकानां वेद माधवः॥१०॥
verses.english: Theo-hypothecators, say वेदान्तिन्-s, remained conjectural about the extreme beginning and ending of nArAyaNa, but they carry on with the time-honoured knowledge of agreed significance of nArAyaNa…
verses.bhavadeepa: एष इति। यथा तन्तुभिः पटः कल्पितः एवं लोकैः हरेः शरीरं कल्प्यते। यथा च पटः केवलं पृथ्वीमयः एवं लोकाः विष्णुमयाः एवं देवेष्वपि योज्यम्॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: अस्य देवान्धकारस्य मार्गितव्यस्य दैवतैः। शृणु वै यत्तदा वृत्तं ब्रह्मलोके पुरातनम्॥११॥
verses.english: Theo-hypothecators, say वेदान्तिन्-s, remained conjectural about the extreme beginning and ending of nArAyaNa, but they carry on with the time-honoured knowledge of agreed significance of nArAyaNa…
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्येति। लोकानां परम् अत एव तेभ्यः परं च आत्मानं वेद॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा ब्रह्मणो लोकं दृष्ट्वा पैतामहं पदम्। ववन्दे तानृषीन्सर्वान्विष्णुरार्षेण कर्मणा॥१२॥
verses.english: Whatever intrinsic factor of gods is there that is from janArdana… and whatever extrinsic factor emerges from the gods is the emanation from मधुसूदन… scholars are aware of it…
verses.bhavadeepa: देवानाम् इन्द्रियाणाम् अन्धकार आवरणं यस्मिन् विषये वेदानामिति पाठे वा इन्द्रियाणां गिरां चाविषयस्येत्यर्थः॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: सोऽग्निं प्राक्सवणे दृष्ट्वा हूयमानं महर्षिभिः। अवन्दत महातेजाः कृत्वा पौर्वाह्निकीं क्रियाम्॥१३॥
verses.english: When great resplendent sages of brahma’s abode are performing morning time Vedic rituals, viShNu saw his own mirror-image surging up from the centre of the altar of fire in the early morning ritual, while the sages held it in reverence… it happened likewise in the ritual conducted in that pre-noon…
verses.bhavadeepa: आर्षेण मन्त्रप्रतिपाद्येन॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: स ददर्श मखेष्वाज्यैरिज्यमानं महर्षिभिः। भागं यज्ञियमश्नानं स्वदेहमपरं स्थितम्॥१४॥
verses.english: When great resplendent sages of brahma’s abode are performing morning time Vedic rituals, viShNu saw his own mirror-image surging up from the centre of the altar of fire in the early morning ritual, while the sages held it in reverence… it happened likewise in the ritual conducted in that pre-noon…
verses.bhavadeepa: प्राक्सवने प्रातःसवने॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: अभिवाद्याभिवाद्यानामृषीणां ब्रह्मवर्चसाम्। परिचक्राम सोऽचिन्त्यो ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्॥१५॥
verses.english: Then, he who is beyond the comprehension, that nArAyaNa began to range in the eternal abode of brahma going on saluting the worshipful sages of brahma energy, who are wide spread in that abode performing vedic rituals, and who all are seeing viShNu alone in the fire-altars available in their fore, because viShNu is yaj~na-swarUpa for them…

verses.sanskrit: स ददर्शोच्छ्रितान्यूपांश्चषालाग्रविभूषितान्। मखेषु च ब्रह्मर्षिभिः शतशः कृतलक्षणान्॥१६॥
verses.english: Then, he who is beyond the comprehension, that nArAyaNa began to range in the eternal abode of brahma going on saluting the worshipful sages of brahma energy, who are wide spread in that abode performing vedic rituals, and who all are seeing viShNu alone in the fire-altars available in their fore, because viShNu is yaj~na-swarUpa for them…
verses.bhavadeepa: ऋषीणाम् ऋषीन्॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: आज्यधूमं समाघ्राय शृण्वन्वेदान्द्विजेरितान्। यज्ञैरिज्यं तमात्मानं पश्यंस्तत्र चचार ह॥१७॥
verses.english: Going round the sacrificial halls he noticed tall sacrificial posts with tops adorned well, which posts again reflected his images… even the hundreds of items of ritual that are being used by sages are reflecting his entity… as he walked further smelling the smoke of fire-oblations and listening vedic chants recited by scholars, he has noticed himself mirrored in every item of ritual…

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुस्तमृषयो देवाः सदस्याः सदसि स्थिताः। अर्घोद्यतभुजाः सर्वे पवित्रान्तरपाणयः॥१८॥
verses.english: The sages and the gods available in the assemblages of Vedic ritiual then addressed the visitor, viShNu, interspersing sacred grass in their fingers and placing a vessel with sacred water – अर्घ्य – water for canon-welcome, in the bowl of their palms that are a little upraised to their chest level, calling this to mind:
verses.bhavadeepa: इज्यन्तम् इज्यमानम् आत्मानं विग्रहान्तरं दधानम्॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: देवेषु वर्तते यद्वै तद्धि सर्वं जनार्दनात्। यत्प्रवृत्तं च देवेभ्यस्तद्विद्धि मधुसूदनात्॥१९॥
verses.english: Whatever intrinsic factor of gods is there that is from janArdana… and whatever extrinsic factor emerges from the gods is the emanation from मधुसूदन… scholars are aware of it…

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोममयं लोकं यं विदुर्विदुषो जनाः। तं सोममग्निं लोकं च वेद विष्णुं सनातनम्॥२०॥
verses.english: If the existence of ultramundane soul is asseverated with sense data, so shrIhari too is perceptible by way of gods, Veda-s and by the very existence of world…
verses.bhavadeepa: यत् सामर्थ्यादिकं विद्धीति ते प्रत्यक्षमपि परोक्षत्वेन जानन्तः कथयन्ति॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: क्षीराद्यथा दधि भवेद्दध्नः सर्पिर्भवेद्यथा। मथ्यमानेषु भूतेषु तथा लोको जनार्दनात्॥२१॥
verses.english: If the existence of ultramundane soul is asseverated with sense data, so shrIhari too is perceptible by way of gods, Veda-s and by the very existence of world…
verses.bhavadeepa: विदुषः सकाशात् वेद भवानिति शेषः॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: यथेन्द्रियैश्च भुतैश्च परमात्माभिधीयते। तथा देवैश्च वेदैश्च लोकैश्च विहितो हरिः॥२२॥
verses.english: As to how living beings are endowed with the faculties of senses, so the gods are endowed with viShNu’s basic endowments, namely प्राण – here might, ईश्वर – ऐश्वर्यम्, flourish in every way, from out of his basic attributes, like ज्ञान – omniscience; बल omnipotence; ऐश्वर्य flourish; शक्ति creative power, वीर्य immutability; and तेज – self-effulgence…
verses.bhavadeepa: भूतेषु देहेन्द्रियादिषु मथ्यमानेषु ध्यानबलेन प्रविलाप्यमानेषु सत्सु अन्तर्दृष्ट्या जनार्दनादेवायं लोको भवतीति गम्यते। ईक्षामात्रनिर्वृतत्वाल्लोकस्य अत्र क्रमेण अव्याकृत ईक्षणे जगतां क्रमात् क्षीरदधिसर्पीषि दृष्टान्ताः॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: यथा भूतेन्द्रियावाप्तिर्विहिता भुवि देहिनाम्। तथा प्राणेश्वरावाप्तिर्देवानां दिवि वैष्णवी॥२३॥
verses.english: As to how living beings are endowed with the faculties of senses, so the gods are endowed with viShNu’s basic endowments, namely प्राण – here might, ईश्वर – ऐश्वर्यम्, flourish in every way, from out of his basic attributes, like ज्ञान – omniscience; बल omnipotence; ऐश्वर्य flourish; शक्ति creative power, वीर्य immutability; and तेज – self-effulgence…
verses.bhavadeepa: इन्द्रियभूतैः चेतनाव्याप्तै परमात्मा स्वयमेव गोचरोऽपि विधीयत अज्ञातो ज्ञाप्यते तथा देवादिभिरनुग्रहादिकर्तृभिर्विष्णुरित्यर्थः। चित्तमात्मन इव नियन्तृत्वं विष्णोरेवेति भावः। अभिधीयते विदित इति पाठेऽपि स एवार्थः॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: सत्रिणां सत्रफलदः पवित्रं परमात्मवान्। लोकतन्त्रधरो ह्येष मन्त्रैर्मन्त्र इवोच्यते॥२४॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the forty-ninth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating an account of the worlds.
verses.bhavadeepa: यथेति। जीवानां भूतेन्द्रियसम्बन्धो भुवि भूतेभ्यो यथा दृष्ट एवं देवानां प्राणो बलम् ईश्वरः ऐश्वर्यं तदुभयेन सम्बन्धो विष्णुतो भवतीत्यर्थः॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषय ऊचुः।
              स्वागतं ते सुरश्रेष्ठ पद्मनाभ महाद्युते। इदं यज्ञियमातिथ्यं मन्त्रतः परिगृह्यताम्॥२५॥
verses.english: Whatever fruit of action in performing a Vedic ritual that is replete with donations is there, let that accrue to us, because we the officiators as well as conductors of vedic rituals in this abode of brahma, already received an unsurpassable donation from you, namely your divine revelation to us… incidentally you too have seen yourself in every bit of our vedic ritual and we too do not see none other than you either in our rituals or in our percipience…” so said sages to viShNu.
verses.bhavadeepa: आत्मवान् स्वतन्त्रः मन्त्रैर्मन्त्र इवोच्यते इति यथा वाचो माधुर्यं वाचैव वर्णनीयम् एवं विष्णोः स्वरूपं विष्णुनैवार्चनीयमित्यर्थः॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: त्वमस्य यज्ञपूतस्य पात्रं पाद्यस्य पावनः। अतिथिस्त्वं हि मन्त्रोक्तः स दृष्टः सन्ततं मतः॥२६॥
verses.english: Ever since thy departure to combat demons, oh, viShNu, unstirred is our ritual activity for a vedic ritual without viShNu is unsanctioned…

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि योद्धुं गते विष्णौ न प्रावर्तन्त नः क्रियाः। अवैष्णवस्य यज्ञस्य न हि कर्म विधीयते॥२७॥
verses.english: Whatever fruit of action in performing a Vedic ritual that is replete with donations is there, let that accrue to us, because we the officiators as well as conductors of vedic rituals in this abode of brahma, already received an unsurpassable donation from you, namely your divine revelation to us… incidentally you too have seen yourself in every bit of our vedic ritual and we too do not see none other than you either in our rituals or in our percipience…” so said sages to viShNu.

verses.sanskrit: सदक्षिणस्य यज्ञस्य त्वत्प्रसूतिः फलं भवेत्। अद्यात्मानमिहास्माभिरिज्यमानं निरीक्ष्यसे॥२८॥
verses.english: Saying "so he it" nArAyaNa, in return, worshipped the brAhmaNa-s while grandparent brahma abiding in his region, ब्रह्मलोक, is rejoiced for the successful visit of viShNu…
verses.bhavadeepa: त्वयीत अन्तरात्मनि अन्यत्र व्यापृते कृतोऽपि यज्ञो निष्फल इति भावः॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: एवमस्त्विति तान्सर्वान्भगवान्प्रत्यपूजयत्। मुमुदे बह्मलोकस्थो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः॥२९॥
verses.english: Saying "so he it" nArAyaNa, in return, worshipped the brAhmaNa-s while grandparent brahma abiding in his region, ब्रह्मलोक, is rejoiced for the successful visit of viShNu…
